WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.weathprofile AS condition_name,
    s.snrratio AS quality,
    (s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm)) AS snqi
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
med AS (
  SELECT condition_name,
         ROUND(AVG(quality), 4) AS median_quality
  FROM (
    SELECT condition_name, quality,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY condition_name ORDER BY quality) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY condition_name) AS n
    FROM base
    WHERE quality IS NOT NULL
  )
  WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
  GROUP BY condition_name
)
SELECT
  b.condition_name,
  ROUND(AVG(b.quality), 4) AS avg_quality,
  m.median_quality,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.snqi > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usable_signals
FROM base b
JOIN med m ON m.condition_name = b.condition_name
GROUP BY b.condition_name, m.median_quality
ORDER BY avg_quality DESC;

Here are the results, sorted by average signal quality (SNR) descending:

| Condition (weathprofile) | Avg quality (SNR) | Median quality (SNR) | Usable signals |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clear | 11.48 | 12.02 | 173 |
| Cloudy | 10.23 | 10.78 | 153 |
| Partially Cloudy | 8.57 | 7.48 | 136 |

Signal quality degrades as cloud cover increases: Clear-sky conditions yield the highest average SNR (~11.5) and the most usable signals, while Partially Cloudy conditions give the lowest average (~8.6).

**Interpretation assumptions** (you deferred the ambiguous terms to me):
- **Condition** = `observatories.weathprofile` (the atmospheric/weather condition at the observatory that detected the signal, joined via `signals → telescopes → observatories`).
- **Quality value** = `signals.snrratio` (signal-to-noise ratio, the standard signal-quality metric).
- **Usable signals** = "Analyzable Signals" per the business knowledge base: SNQI > 0, with SNQI approximated as `snrratio − 0.1·|noisefloordbm|` (per the CCS Approximation rule, since SNQI isn't stored directly).

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.weathprofile AS condition_name,
    s.snrratio AS quality,
    (s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm)) AS snqi
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
med AS (
  SELECT condition_name,
         ROUND(AVG(quality), 4) AS median_quality
  FROM (
    SELECT condition_name, quality,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY condition_name ORDER BY quality) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY condition_name) AS n
    FROM base
    WHERE quality IS NOT NULL
  )
  WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
  GROUP BY condition_name
)
SELECT
  b.condition_name,
  ROUND(AVG(b.quality), 4) AS avg_quality,
  m.median_quality,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.snqi > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usable_signals
FROM base b
JOIN med m ON m.condition_name = b.condition_name
GROUP BY b.condition_name, m.median_quality
ORDER BY avg_quality DESC;
```
